name: query_neuroscience_knowledge_base
description: Retrieves authorized clinical and electrophysiological neuroscience literature regarding EEG biomarkers (N100, sensory attenuation, corollary discharge) and schizophrenia psychoeducation.

query.description: Specific scientific or psychoeducational topic to retrieve (e.g., 'N100 sensory attenuation', 'CBTp grounding exercises', 'symptom clusters').

top_k.description: Number of snippets to retrieve (1 to 5). Defaults to 3.

name: trigger_crisis_override
description: Retrieves immediate emergency crisis helpline contact details when severe emotional distress, self-harm, or suicide risk is detected.

region.description: User's region (US, UK, Canada, or International). Defaults to 'US'.
